name: eval-authoring
description: Skills that author and maintain evals for Skillwalker. Scaffold builders (build-skill-eval-scaffold, build-agent-eval-scaffold) generate realistic project fixtures, with a --for trigger mode for repo-context scaffolds; trigger-test writers (write-scil-evals, write-acil-evals) produce skill-call and agent-call tests; rubric writers (write-skill-eval-rubric, write-agent-eval-rubric) produce LLM-judge rubrics and deterministic checks for skill-prompt and agent-prompt tests; audit-evals reports drift between an eval and the target it tests. Depends on nothing; run it from the Skillwalker repo where the target plugin:skill or plugin:agent lives.
